optimized_sql:
SELECT c.c_customer_id, c.c_salutation, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, c.c_preferred_cust_flag, c.c_birth_day, c.c_birth_month, c.c_birth_year, c.c_birth_country, c.c_login, c.c_email_address, c.c_last_review_date_sk, ctr1.ctr_total_return
FROM (
    SELECT ctr_base.ctr_customer_sk, ctr_base.ctr_state, ctr_base.ctr_total_return, AVG(ctr_base.ctr_total_return) OVER (PARTITION BY ctr_base.ctr_state) * 1.2 AS ctr_avg_return
    FROM (
        SELECT wr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk, addr.ca_state AS ctr_state, SUM(wr_return_amt) AS ctr_total_return
        FROM web_returns
        JOIN date_dim AS d ON wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk AND d.d_year = 2000
        JOIN customer_address AS addr ON wr_returning_addr_sk = addr.ca_address_sk
        GROUP BY wr_returning_customer_sk, addr.ca_state
    ) AS ctr_base
    WHERE ctr_base.ctr_state IS NOT NULL
) AS ctr1
JOIN customer AS c ON c.c_customer_sk = ctr1.ctr_customer_sk
JOIN (
    SELECT ca_address_sk
    FROM customer_address
    WHERE ca_state = 'AR'
) AS ca ON ca.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk
WHERE ctr1.ctr_total_return > ctr1.ctr_avg_return
ORDER BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_salutation, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, c.c_preferred_cust_flag, c.c_birth_day, c.c_birth_month, c.c_birth_year, c.c_birth_country, c.c_login, c.c_email_address, c.c_last_review_date_sk, ctr1.ctr_total_return
LIMIT 100
